user.title: Set up Airport-aware Flight Itinerary
user.description: Store itineraries locally. No account or schedule provider is required.

init.title: Optional flight tracking
init.description: Turn off FR24 connection for schedule-only use. All entity selections and automatic-control preferences are retained. Disconnecting does not switch off FR24 itself or remove tracked flights. Select entities from one FR24 entry when connected.

data.fr24_auto_track: Automatically add itinerary flights to FR24 tracking
data.fr24_auto_disable: Shut down fetching sessions started by this integration

error.select_add_to_track_entity: Select the Flightradar24 Add to track text entity to enable automatic tracking.
error.select_tracked_flights_entity: Select the Flightradar24 Additional Tracked sensor to avoid adding flights that are already tracked.
error.select_remove_entity: Select the FR24 Remove from track entity.
error.select_api_switch: Select the FR24 API fetching switch.
error.different_fr24_entry: Select registered entities belonging to the same Flightradar24 configuration entry.
